about.heading: About me
about.subtitle: // who I am
about.desc1: I'm a frontend developer passionate about creating intuitive and accessible web experiences, turning ideas into real products with modern frontend technologies.
about.desc2: My priorities are clean architecture, thoughtful UX, and writing maintainable code that makes both users and developers happy.
about.desc3: Constantly exploring new technologies, I believe it's attention to detail that makes great products memorable.

experience.heading: Experience

tudaSuda.title: Go Tuda
tudaSuda.description: A web app that helps friends pick a meeting place without long group chats. Add people and places, share a form, and see everyone's votes in one table.

chatWidget.title: Chat Widget
chatWidget.description: A reusable React chat widget with an adapter pattern for any backend. TypeScript, a useChat hook, and a ready-made ChatWindow UI.

cutieBoard.title: CutieBoard
cutieBoard.description: A Kanban board with a pink theme: multiple boards, templates, drag-and-drop cards, filters, and localStorage persistence.

btsFanSite.title: BTS Fan Site
btsFanSite.description: A fan-made BTS tribute site with members, discography, and themed UI. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
